description: Use this module to manage order of boot devices.

parameters.name: bootdev
parameters.description: Set boot device to use on next reboot. The choices for the device are: network -- Request network boot. floppy -- Boot from floppy. hd -- Boot from hard drive. safe -- Boot from hard drive, requesting ‘safe mode’. optical -- boot from CD/DVD/BD drive. setup -- Boot into setup utility. default -- remove any IPMI directed boot device request. Choices: "network" "floppy" "hd" "safe" "optical" "setup" "default"

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Encryption key to connect to the BMC in hex format.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Hostname or IP address of the BMC.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password to connect to the BMC.

parameters.name: persistent
parameters.description: If set, ask that system firmware uses this device beyond next boot. Be aware many systems do not honor this. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether to ensure that boot devices is desired. The choices for the state are: - present -- Request system turn on - absent -- Request system turn on. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: uefiboot
parameters.description: If set, request UEFI boot explicitly. Strictly speaking, the spec suggests that if not set, the system should BIOS boot and offers no “do not care” option. In practice, this flag not being set does not preclude UEFI boot on any system I have encountered. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Username to use to connect to the BMC.

examples:
- name: Ensure bootdevice is HD
  community.general.ipmi_boot:
    name: test.testdomain.com
    user: admin
    password: password
    bootdev: hd

- name: Ensure bootdevice is not Network
  community.general.ipmi_boot:
    name: test.testdomain.com
    user: admin
    password: password
    key: 1234567890AABBCCDEFF000000EEEE12
    bootdev: network
    state: absent

return_values.name: bootdev
return_values.description: The boot device name which is used beyond next boot. Returned: success Sample: "default"

return_values.name: persistent
return_values.description: If true, system firmware uses this device beyond next boot. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: uefimode
return_values.description: If true, system firmware uses UEFI boot explicitly beyond next boot. Returned: success Sample: false
